ucdpMeta.provider: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP), Uppsala University
ucdpMeta.authentication: build-time x-ucdp-access-token header; token is never written to the browser artifact
ucdpMeta.releaseSelection: newest fixed monthly GED Candidate version listed in the official UCDP API documentation at implementation time
ucdpMeta.selection: Fixed immutable UCDP GED Candidate monthly release 26.0.10; the complete release is fetched within a hard page cap, canonical event IDs are deduplicated, then at most 1200 records are retained by local high-value score: log1p(best)*120 + log1p(high)*25 + (8-where_prec)*4 + (6-date_prec)*3 + 10 for event_clarity 1 + 8 for code_status Clear + up to 25 for recency within 45 days of the release's newest date_end.
ucdpMeta.caveat: UCDP Candidate events are preliminary monthly rows: not all candidate events necessarily enter the final annual UCDP GED, and events can be revised or reclassified in later releases. The fixed API version itself is immutable. Fatality low/best/high values are source-estimate intervals, date and location precision codes describe uncertainty, the map timestamp uses date_end while the full date range is retained, and a point for a low-precision event can represent a district, province, country, linear feature, or other approximation rather than the exact incident site.
